title: Phones draw house shadows from simpler shapes
items: On a phone, each house now casts its sun shadow from one simplified copy of itself, near as well as far. Mouldings, sash and trim are smaller than one point of the phone's shadow map, so they never changed a shadow anyway. Looking down Prairie Avenue from 1801 or across 18th Street, the shadow pass draws about 56% fewer house triangles, and fewer than 1 pixel in 1,000 changes. Desktops and the Full and Balanced settings are unchanged.
